real_source.measurement: SIFT outside x=300..620, ratio .7, matches within 30px, RANSAC affine 2px; L* excludes same central band. Same sampler output used for all JoinMatch variants.

color_control.prompt: A locked-off camera films the static, flat color calibration chart in <Picture 1>. The red, green, blue, yellow, purple and cyan rectangular panels, white borders, black circles and straight lines remain completely still and unchanged. Preserve their exact positions, sizes, proportions and colors. Constant neutral lighting. Silent.

limits: One real source, fixed seed, first pass only; not final 1080p validation.
Color charts are synthetic and results are specific to installed model, acceleration LoRA and schedule.
hard39 changes both context method and length; not an isolated mask-strength comparison.
No guarantee of zero drift in newly generated frames or long chains.
